input.relationship: 提供一个双方属主能够采纳的兼容修改建议。src/availability.ts#roomSummary call src/intervals.ts#capacity (forward)

evidence.reason: Returned object now exposes used as the primary enumerable property and occupied only as a non-enumerable getter alias, changing the shape of the returned object.
Reads capacity.occupied; this still works through the getter alias, so the merged behavior does not break this caller.
Reads capacity.used, which is the new primary property and remains compatible.
Reads capacity(...).available, which is unchanged by both edits.

result.userExplanation: 两处修改合并后 roomSummary 仍能通过 getter 别名读取 occupied，但该别名不可枚举且缺少测试验证，存在兼容性风险。
